verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party Cloudflare documentation citation specifically laying out rate limits, concurrency caps, or CPU-time limits for Workers/APIs; the only concrete numbers come from a community comment noting '30s CPU time on the free tier and 15min on paid plans' which developers found insufficient for long-running agent tasks, implying such limits exist and are known but are a pain point rather than clearly documented in the pack. Missing for 10: an official Cloudflare 'Limits' docs page, explicit concurrency cap numbers, and independent corroboration that these limits are clearly published for capacity planning.
